data.name: Musket Master
data.description: Pistols and other one-handed firearms are often easy to conceal and faster to load than other firearms, and do suff icient damage for most situations. But some gunslingers want a little more firepower and range. These are the musket masters; the best of these gunslingers can reload a musket with dazzling speed, potentially putting even their pistol-wielding brethren to shame.
